network: The owner's laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Transfer times include that path.

endpoints.earth_search_use: Selection metadata only: Collection 1 candidates and Level-1C datastrips. No Collection 1 pixel is read.
endpoints.payer: Bucket owner. Every request was unsigned, so no requester was charged. A requester-pays bucket refuses unsigned requests.

pairing_rule:
The Collection 1 item of the same datastrip as one aquatic reflectance product.

    Status values:
    datastrip, exactly one Collection 1 item shares the datastrip.
    datastrip_multiple, several share it. The latest created is chosen and the rest listed.
    no_c1_item, the datastrip is known and no Collection 1 item declares it.
    no_l1c_item, Earth Search holds no Level-1C item of the input name.
    l1c_ambiguous, the Level-1C items of that name declare more than one datastrip.

source_history.reason: Stage 4 stand-ins gained the header check that stages 2 and 3 already had. Added a header verification mode, this source-change record, run-time digests, and collation of a workload part that did not run. Stages 2 to 4 ran before the change. No workload phase had launched.

limitations: The cohorts are the earlier lakes, restricted to acquisitions the primary product holds. Where a lake's earlier acquisition is missing, the unchanged rules choose another one. Tile-dates therefore differ in part from the Level-2A reference. Each part reports how many match.
Selection ranks candidates by the paired Collection 1 item's metadata: footprint, cloud cover, datastrip, and creation time. The primary product has no catalog that states them.
Five layers per product, the earlier band set's counterparts. The primary product holds 13 raster layers. A store of every layer reads more files per product.
Laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Times are not AWS estimates.
Requests and bytes come from GDAL's debug log of requested ranges, not metered transfer.
One run per part on one day. Provider, operating-system, and network caches are not controlled. Timing repetitions are those of each earlier script.
Intermediate stage files under data/ come from the unchanged scripts and keep their Collection 1 wording in places. This result's endpoints block is authoritative.
